clash/proxy-all/2:
dns:
  enable: true
  enhanced-mode: fake-ip
  fake-ip-range: 198.18.0.1/16
  fake-ip-filter:
    - "*.lan"
    - "+.local"
  default-nameserver:
    - 1.1.1.1
    - 8.8.8.8
  proxy-server-nameserver:
    - 1.1.1.1
    - 8.8.8.8
  nameserver:
    - https://1.1.1.1/dns-query
    - https://dns.google/dns-query

proxies:
  - name: n1-xray
    type: vless
    server: n.example.com
    port: 443
    uuid: 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
    network: tcp
    tls: true
    udp: true
    servername: www.example.com
    client-fingerprint: chrome
    reality-opts:
      public-key: PUB
      short-id: S
  - name: n2-xray
    type: vless
    server: n.example.com
    port: 443
    uuid: 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222
    network: tcp
    tls: true
    udp: true
    servername: www.example.com
    client-fingerprint: chrome
    reality-opts:
      public-key: PUB
      short-id: S

proxy-groups:
  - name: Auto
    type: url-test
    url: http://www.gstatic.com/generate_204
    interval: 300
    proxies:
      - n1-xray
      - n2-xray

rules:
  - MATCH,Auto
